retrievalProfile.description: A portrait-centered layout framed by a distressed 35mm film strip border with high-contrast, condensed typography overlaid on a natural landscape.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central square photographic portrait of a man in Western attire, set against a blue water horizon, encased within a thick black border featuring white film sprocket holes and rusted, distressed textures. The layout uses wide-tracked secondary text in the margins and large, tall, textured primary text overlapping the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by a literal film strip metaphor
High-contrast between dark clothing and bright blue background
Textural harmony between the rusted border and the distressed font fill
Verticality of the main text balancing the horizontal horizon line
coreInvariants: Black film strip border with white rectangular sprockets
Distressed/gritty texture on the frame and main text
Centralized human subject in Western wear

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, subject positioned slightly off-center to the left, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and cowboy hat, followed by the large textured name overlay.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down to the hands, then right to the large display text, finally circling the film strip border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky and water to the right of the subject provide room for the primary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest green (shirt) and sky blue (background).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Rust orange/brown (distressed texture) and pale yellow (secondary text).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues and greens, contrasted with the flat black and white of the graphic frame.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy and natural tones

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are vertically elongated to fill the height of the lower-right quadrant
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between extremely condensed display type and widely tracked, standard-width metadata type.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary height and condensed width for the display text.
Classic Americana feel for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man in a cowboy hat and dark green button-down shirt standing in front of a blue lake and sky. Frame this image with a thick black border featuring white film sprocket holes and heavy rust/grunge textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, vertically elongated, extra-condensed sans-serif text in the lower right, applying a grainy texture to the fill. Add small, widely-spaced yellow sans-serif text centered in the top and bottom black margins.

verificationChecks: Is the film strip border distressed with rust?
Is the main text extra-condensed and tall?
Is the margin text widely tracked?
Does the subject wear a cowboy hat?

adjustableVariables: Width of the film strip border
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between display and metadata text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the film sprockets are white rectangles on black.
Ensure the display text has a weathered texture.
Verify the wide tracking on the margin text.
Confirm the subject is in Western attire.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a [Subject Type] portrait, place it inside a [Distressed Film Strip Frame], overlay [Extra-Condensed Textured Type] on the right, and place [Wide-Tracked Metadata] in the margins.
